notes.title: New Major Update: Kruger Update
notes.content:
[h2][b]Kruger Update is here! 🦁[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Hey Giants!  [/p][p][/p][p]The Kruger Update is now live with changes for the Savanna biome. You can read the [b]full Patch Notes at the end of this Steam News.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/28d4d9df22cf271ba8474fe822fc82750dbccd21.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Check our Steam News highlighting two new biotica the [b]Meerkat and the Hamadryas Baboon:[/b][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1875060/view/552373116697838394"]Reus 2 - Teaser Kruger Update: New residents! 🐒 - Steam News[/url][/p][h3]
[b]Gamepad and Steamdeck Support feedback:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This update also comes with some new work on the Gamepad/Steamdeck version of the game. While we're working on the content roadmap, we're also experimenting with gamepad support. We hope to make Reus 2 a better experience using a controller or your Steam Deck.[/p][p]Gamepad & Steam Deck support are a big step for us as they require quite some UI and Input rework. It's also relatively new to Abbey Games. So as always, we're aiming to develop this in further in tandem with the community. Will you help us test this gamepad adaptation?[/p][h3]
How to access the experimental branch to test it?[/h3][p]To opt in to the playtest branch, use the Steam beta password: [i]`CatAteTheMouse`[/i][/p][p]Please share your feedback on all things good and bad in a separate forum thread per issue or cluster of issues.[/p][p]As always, thank you for any help, and we hope you enjoy![/p][p][/p][h3]What feedback are we looking for?[/h3][p]- All feedback on how your experience with the game is, specifically to the way it controls.[/p][p]- This build also supports Mouse+Keyboard as before, so testing for regression issues with default PC controls is welcome too.[/p][p]- Since we are not veteran Steam Deck users ourselves, we hope to learn how your experience beyond standard gamepad controls is.[/p][p][i]Known issues:[/i][/p][p]- The controls layout UI always shows a generic gamepad, rather than specific Steam Deck visual.[/p][p]- Navigation is quirky in some places.[/p][p]- Some UIs still overlap.[/p][p][/p][p]We need all the feedback you can give to help us improve this version for its official release. You can share your feedback on [url="https://discord.gg/w92kY4sQ"]Discord [/url]or in the Steam discussions in the dedicated channel and [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1875060/discussions/5/554627540143114282/"](newly created) sub-forum[/url]! Thank you all for helping us shaping Reus 2's future!
[/p][p]On a side note, we also have a [b]Daily Deal[/b] on Steam with [b]a 40% sale on the main game, 10% on the Supporter Pack and 20% on the DLCs[/b] starting[b] today at 7PM CEST![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/c6acf4b3bb66ed0663f28b0441343e44610c4f81.png"][/img][/p][p]Enjoy this new update and stay tuned for the next one! [/p][p][/p][p]-Manuel and the Monks at the Abbey[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Patch Notes v.1.9.0:[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]ADDED:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]\[3-star APEX] Meerkat: Turns fields into Herbivores, and elements into food. [/p][/*][*][p]\[3-star APEX] Baboon: Scales with all biotica that react to their row.[/p][/*][*][p]Pygmy Falcon: a small raptor.[/p][/*][*][p]Termite Hill: an Element that bombs Termites.[/p][/*][*][p]Hoopoe: a bird living between the animals.[/p][/*][*][p]Shepherd Tree: a tree that hosts the Weaver birds[/p][/*][*][p]Added female/male skins for a couple animals such as Lion ad Ostrich[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]CHANGED:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Removed the Savanna Herd, Nut, and Prey tag, as they were virtually doing nothing[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Sunset" tag to determine In-Row using biotica.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed altar to use all stats, not just food, of offering biotica.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Cultist kit to give Wealth directly instead of valuables.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Changed unlock order of things a bit to be less overwhelming[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Seagrass to boost adjacent to an animal[/p][/*][*][p]Added some clarity on why certain biomes can't be placed yet[/p][/*][*][p]Planets are no longer lost upon giants dying in them. Along with a feature that prevents autosaves below 40% health, the player can now always continue planets after they lost.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Galactic Empire and Galactic Golden Age achievements (translations pending)[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BALANCE:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Almost all Biotica from the Savanna have been changed! Playing with rows should be much better supported![/p][/*][*][p]Dromedary loses Oryx, gains Turqouise[/p][/*][*][p]Pomegranate loses Fig, gains Methane[/p][/*][*][p]Cotton loses Damask Rose, gains Fig[/p][/*][*][p]Tropical Paradise gives 5 food for mystery instead of 8[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed Moose a bit.[/p][/*][*][p]Ranger Power Rebalance[/p][/*][*][p]Staghorn Coral and Alunite balance changes.[/p][/*][*][p]Stop giving the Poet military base[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed petrified woods, made termite hill a bit less bonkers, added some micro havens[/p][/*][*][p][i]\[ICEAGE][/i] Glacial Erratics and Kettle Lake no longer can be placed in the Savanna[/p][/*][*][p][i]\[WETLANDS][/i] Romantic loses 2 food from mystery (now 3/2/2)[/p][/*][*][p][i]\[WETLANDS][/i] Romantic gains Lighthouse instead of Marine Ecological Institute[/p][/*][*][p][i]\[WETLANDS][/i] Romantic Mansion changed to count biotica with double yield[/p][/*][*][p][i]\[WETLANDS][/i] Cathedral changed to count biotica with a base mystery yield.[/p][/*][*][p][i]\[WETLANDS][/i] Zen garden down to +5 food per mystery.[/p][/*][*][p][i]\[WETLANDS][/i] Ranger emblems toned down a bit[/p][/*][*][p][i]\[WETLANDS][/i] Entomologists power now only targets Cohorts[/p][/*][*][p][i]\[WETLANDS][/i] Entomologist needs less Micros but more science for his quests[/p][/*][*][p][i]\[WETLANDS][/i] Zoo down a notch[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]FIXED:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug in Distinct Tag always picking the lowest of options.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that removed a draft if you had a mono biome planet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Catfish upgrading wrong biotica.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased protection against profile corruption[/p][/*][*][p]Micro Visuals are now properly removed after upgrading a patch[/p][/*][*][p]Anomaly and invasive spot now behave consistently. notes.title: Teaser Kruger Update: New residents! 🐒
notes.content: [p]Hello, Jangwa movers! 🦁[/p][p][/p][p]This week, we’d love to showcase our two new Apex friends coming next week, the [b]Meerkat and the Hamadryas Baboon[/b]. Let’s take a look![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/985890da614f404fdcff22a543b195a52657616c.png"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Hamadryas Baboon[/b] is designed to be a flexible Animal to add to your pack. It gives unorthodox gains for an animal, as long as you placed many [i]<Sunset>[/i] biotica. You’ll find yourself looking for good row synergies. But you also want to utilize its own Sunset ability with animals! Make sure to reserve a row to stack animals. It will work great with the herd animals, like the reworked Wildebeest, and collect many small bonuses from cohorts, like the reworked Egusi.  [/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/3f8b8b69f9422c2dcccd86a0b8bfa2152a614d1d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/a402040f11add8f4db161a7ff06c8a73275d1259.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]When looking for a matching Tier 3 Apex, look for those that also want animals - like the Elephant - or that bring a lot of Sunset abilities to the table - like the Sorghum! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/6decf9a85c55276ba52a212ffb15fd4e87eef270.png"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Meerkat[/b] can take up a scoring or a support role. Its Sunset ability scales well and is worth investing. However, Field Sentinel allows you to gain a multitude of Herbivores out of thin air. All for the cheap price of 5 Biodiversity. It is supported by an incredibly powerful Termite Hill that provides plenty of [i]<Element>[/i] tags. It’s almost like having 2 Apex for the price of 1!  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/d149b62ba8b9371cc97cf1cc0b3ad0dea103ec25.png"][/img][/p][p]How will you use the Meerkat? Will they boost your animal kingdom, will they burrow their way to massive food gains? [/p][p][b]More Content:[/b] There are 3 other new cohorts we haven’t talked about: the Hoopoe, Pygmy Falcon, and Shepherd Tree. But we’ll let you figure those out yourself! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/e902bfacf4c264081e34ac2006b894158d15dd37.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]And a little bonus:[/b] the Bullfrog also has been changed! Now it provides a bioticum with all possible types! It might be a bit niche, but there are plenty of useful ways to get a lot out of those extra micro charges! [/p][p]We hope to see your new worlds next week on [b]September the 12th[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]- Greetings from the Abbey [/p]

notes.title: Our fifth Roadmap & Coming soon: The Kruger Update
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, titanic friends!   [/p][p][/p][p]We have a lot of exciting news to share with you on Reus 2! Let’s cut to the chase, and highlight the new roadmap! 🗺️   [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/b6d191fdc4a165881da9fe0ba86171890a31a1b4.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p] [b]Kruger Update - September 12th:[/b] an exciting update that not only adds 2 brand new apexes and 4 new cohorts, but hosts a complete overhaul of the Savanna! Scroll down to read more! ⬇️
[/p][/*][*][p] [b]Nikko Update - November 2025:[/b]  A smaller update with focus on new features. One of them will allow you to randomize secondary biomes too, for brand new Horizon options! [/p][p][/p][/*][*][p] [b]Manchuria Update + DLC - 2026:[/b] I don’t want to spoil much about this update yet, but let’s just say it will add a lot of new biotica…  [/p][/*][/list][h2]Kruger Update: Savanna Rework[/h2][p][/p][p]Players have pointed out that the Savanna was the only biome to not have received an upgrade since launch. Well, say no more! Our goals with the Kruger Update are: [/p][list][*][p] Animals: Add more Animals to the Savanna to give that Safari vibe.
[/p][/*][*][p] Rows: Make row gameplay much more viable and synergetic
[/p][/*][*][p] Quality: Improve the general quality of the content so all paths have something special.[/p][/*][/list][p]
To do that, we touched almost every bioticum in the Savanna, and added a few to boot!
One thing you’ll notice immediately is that [i]<Prey>[/i] and [i]<Savanna Herd>[/i] are gone. They were hardly used. The [i]<Grass>[/i] is replaced with the more general [i]<Field>[/i], which allows more Biotica to participate. Take a look at the Red Oat, a Savanna staple:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/5dfa7324ee11fd578b5dbdd2381f7024a2eb5dfd.png"][/img][/p][p]Notice not only the [i]<Field>[/i] tag, but also the [i]<Sunset>[/i] tag: a new tag that highlights Biotica which uses in-row symbioses. You will find many more of them. Take a look at some of these reworks! [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/78eefd74a10c597048e54d6b8f94e6bd8f52df16.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re also adding a new Third Era, [b]the Safari Planet[/b]! It challenges you to create a planet with mostly animals and score big with a Herbivore and Predator.
We’re also adding some cool female/male skins for some animals! The Savanna deserves as much![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/b65607db824ed0bbeaaa6ee3ee7919c4d01caa90.png"][/img] [/p][p] 🦁 Tune in next week to read more about the 2 new Apex: The Meerkat and the Hamadryas Baboon![/p][p][/p][h3]And talking about Savanna, check out the amazing [b]Pikminenco[/b]'s video on how to bring the Giant Jangwa to life![/h3][previewyoutube="A-O6oBE1t4w;full"][/previewyoutube][p] Greetings from the Abbey!

-Adriaan and the Monks from the Abbey [/p]

notes.title: 1 year anniversary release of Reus 2, how far we’ve come! 🎂
notes.content:
Hey Giants!

It’s been a year since Reus 2 was released, and so many amazing things have happened, we had to celebrate this with you. Whether you’re here since Reus 1, or you’ve just discovered Reus 2 with the latest update, you’re part of our great community, and we would not be here without you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/86d4e530a2d3125bb7a483273a96c2beba1650ae.gif[/img]

Reus 2 continues to grow, with DLC and updates, and you’re still here with us so thank you, this celebration is also yours.

[h3][b]Not 1, not 2, but 3 winners for our giveaway[/b][/h3]

And to truly celebrate this anniversary, we wanted to do a special giveaway with 3 winners who can win the all-included edition of Reus 2, which contains the main game, the Ice Age DLC and the Supporter Pack! You can even gift your prize to a loved one so you can share your best symbiosis together!

[h3]🎁 Participate in the giveaway [url=https://gleam.io/JPa87/reus-2-1-year-anniversary]HERE[/url]! 🎁[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/43e4b4d154a39841dc2c64a0b914f0dacb9ca43c.png[/img]

[h3][b]A fantastic journey[/b][/h3]

The monks have been working hard on keeping Reus 2 fresh and fun! We’d like to highlight the updates released this year:
[list]
[*] [b]Spirited World:[/b] the first update added the Botanist and Diplomat to the game.
[*] [b]Zhangjiajie Milestone:[/b] Added Simplified Chinese and some China based content.
[*] [b]Great Barrier Reef:[/b] A big update for the Ocean; The Dolphin, Reef Shark, Christmas Tree Coral and Shipwreck were added!
[*] [b]Central Park Update:[/b] This is where you get your Kentucky coffee trees and doves. It was a small surprise!
[*] [b]Atlantic Forest:[/b] A big one! New giant abilities like Anomaly, a package of rainforest biotica, and the tropical paradise era.
[*] [b]Amur Update:[/b] The City of Dreams and Small World is added next to some new Taiga content. The last big free content update.
[*] [b]Cataclysm & Ice Age:[/b] The return of wars and relationships! Many people were waiting for it, many people were unsure about it. In the end, we only had 1 complaint. And that person didn’t discover they could just turn off the conflicts. The DLC was super fun to make, and exceeded our expectations!
[*] [b]Micro Kingdom:[/b] Not full of content, but a big shift in gameplay! Better modes, and a whole new micro and emblem system.
[*] [b]Uluru Update:[/b] Bringing more life from the outback to the desert. We hope you’ll enjoy the new content.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/e7451bae6c5621b7fd5ae6044999ae699b592769.png[/img]
We’re very proud of all the quality and work we delivered, and the reviews seem to agree. We’re proud to be still rated [b]overwhelmingly positive[/b]! Not only that: Reus 2 has now been played over [b]a million hours[/b]! We sincerely hope those hours brought you fun, solace, relaxation or otherwise healthy things that help you improve the world in your own way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/190ddb1bf3b464b951448533393ce900903b66be.png[/img]

Another thing that caught us by surprise was where you all hail from. Especially China (23% of the players) and Germany (7%) have been relatively well represented. It’s a privilege to be connected to so many people around the world! We know our German neighbours pretty well, but to see so many Chinese nature enthusiasts warms our hearts. It’s great to see people coming together over a good game with a nice theme. Thank you for your trust, and we hope to see you more in the future!

For those curious about the player counts, this is the top 10:
[olist]
[*] [b]USA[/b] with 28%
[*] [b]China[/b] with 23%
[*] [b]Germany[/b] with 7%
[*] [b]UK[/b] with 4.5%
[*] [b]Canada[/b] with 4%
[*] [b]France [/b]with 4%
[*] [b]Australia[/b] with 2.6%
[*] [b]Russia[/b] with 2.6%
[*] [b]Netherlands[/b] with 2.3%
[*] [b]Brazil[/b] with 1.9%
[/olist]
And just for fun, there is one country where we sold exactly 10 copies: the dreaded, the infamous, [b]Faroe Islands[/b]. And that without any Puffins!

We’d also like to talk about our challenges here at Abbey Games. Maybe you can learn about it?

[b]Team composition:[/b] This year one of our founding members and technical artist Maarten decided to go on his own journey. Reus would not have been possible without him, and we’ve been scrambling to fill the shoes he left us. We’re managing, but above all else we’re grateful for the years of creative collaboration!

[b](Re)Watch Maarten's interview on Reus 2's art direction:[/b]
[previewyoutube=Bl5W2C5k7-Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Keeping Reus 2 Running:[/b] Modern games have high standards, which we’re happy we met! But it also has high support standards! We think we did a fine job with it, together with Firesquid. But it has been more work than in previous years. Finding time to create new stuff has been hard this year.

In the end, though, we can’t be less than very happy and grateful. It has been an amazing journey, which hasn’t ended yet! The Wetlands DLC will be released soon, and we hope to bring more life to your planet.

Have a great day, and enjoy the free update! (as well as this wonderful pixel art made by [i]aswed18[/i] on Discord!)

notes.title: Major Update: Uluru Kata Tjuta Update
notes.content:
Hey Giants!

The sun is out, and the weather already feels like summer. What better moment to bring to the world of Reus 2 new desert content? Lay on the sand (careful not to burn yourself!) and enjoy the new content and the addition of [b]Polish as a new language[/b]! Let’s dig in this new update and you can read the detailed patch notes at the end of this Steam News.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/f1a6615d8d2c4f8407673f1d3029aeccdebbf89c.png[/img]
[h3][b]New Desert content:[/b][/h3]

We added some variety to the Desert! Some friends from the outback will join the roster, like the Eucalyptus tree and the Kangaroo! Moreover, the [b]“Solitary” tag[/b] has been added, highlighting those biotica that just want to be alone or dislike a certain type of biotica, like the Limestone or Falcon!

[b]⚠️ As a reminder, since the update brings a lot of changes to the Micro system, it is not backwards compatible. You won’t be able to revisit old planets & save files after you update the game![/b]
[i]Because of how different the Micro rework is compared to the previous version, you’ll not be able to load planets from before this version (v1.6) anymore. We will keep a fallback version of v1.5 online on a beta branch for anyone who wishes to finish the planets they started before this update, although keep in mind that the meta-progression will remain with this update. If you have further questions regarding this update, feel free to reach out to us.[/i]

Micro won’t be Giant dependent anymore and instead, the Micro ability of a Giant opens the [b]"Micro Shop"[/b]. You will start each game with 2 random common Micros you can place and you don't consume the micro. As long as you have charges, you can place multiple Micros, however, some Micros increase in cost every time you use them, so be careful! https://steamcommunity.com/games/1875060/announcements/detail/508447709615621592?snr=2___

Max Horizon will replace Horizon Draft as the default Draft Mode, but with 3 Biotica of the highest level (one for each starting biome) instead of 1 of each level. The drafting has also become more strict on higher difficulties.

[h3][b]QoL & Balance changes[/b][/h3]

[*] Massive rebalance of dozens of biotica and eras

notes.title: Micro Kingdom Update Explainer
notes.content:
Hello planetary guardians,

Today I would like to go through the upcoming changes on [b]Micros[/b] in the upcoming [b]Micro Kingdom Update![/b] I will go through the design goals first, and then move to the new system!

[h2]Design Goals[/h2]
We love what Reus 2 has to offer, and we often play it ourselves as well! But two things have always stood out as a problem. If we could just fix those, we feel Reus 2 would be in tip-top shape!

[b]Micro Slog[/b]
The first is that placing Micros is not fun enough. They can be fun if you need to squeeze some extra juice out of your Biotica when you're trying to hit a goal. But when you secured your 3 stars, using all your Micros quickly becomes a slog. This also hurts the fun of getting highscores.

[b]Unused Content[/b]
Too often I hear players stick to their reliable combo. We have [b]over 300 Biotica[/b] to play with, but I often hear about giants that just put down a Sequoia or Uranium in all of their games. The game doesn't really help you to try new strategies. There is Horizon Draft, but many have found this not being strict enough.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
In the upcoming Micro Kingdom Update, there are going to be some big changes targeted at these problems.

[b]Micro Rework[/b]
First, Micros will no longer be bought in booster packs of 3, with random outcome. Also, it won't be Giant dependent anymore.

Instead, the Micro ability of a Giant opens the "Micro Shop". You will start each game with 2 random common Micros you can place. Unlike before, you don't consume the micro. As long as you have charges, you can place multiple Worms, Flies or Mushrooms! Some Micros increase in cost every time you use them though, so be careful!

Every Era, you gain 1 new Micro option, at least 5 at the final Era. Each Era has a theme:
[list]
[*] Starting Micros will have 1 flat boost, and 1 percentage booster.
[*] First era Micros will play with a specific rule, and could be specific to one of your biomes.
[*] Second era Micros will have a strong flat boost and could add Tags to create more combos.
[*] Third era Micros are finishers: they give a massive boost to a specific type or resource, but increase in cost!
[/list]
You will gain more Micro charges for having different biomes, but your charges will be lost when going to a new Era. You won't be able to hoard charges as well as before! Hopefully this will make Micros a more integrated part of your gameplan and reduce the slog at the end!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/a5ddaef134bfcbd9026d7e9a57bf282f5452d699.png[/img]
[b]Emblem Rework[/b]
But Adriaan, what about the Emblems? Well, those have been changed as well! Instead of getting something similar to a Micro, Population now grants a global minor power that becomes stronger with more population. For example, having a large population for the Inventor will boost the Science gained by unique biotica with a flat science yield.

This means that strategically increasing the population might become a bigger boon for your planet. Finally a good reason to raise the Miner's population to 50!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/241be317510dd614782fade941868c306bf09b25.png[/img]
[b]Max Horizon & Profiles[/b]
Finally, [b]Max Horizon[/b] will replace Horizon Draft as the default Draft Mode. It's so obvious, I hit myself on the head for not coming up with it earlier! Max Horizon is like Horizon Draft, but with 3 Biotica of the highest level (one for each starting biome) instead of 1 of each level. The drafting has also become more strict on higher difficulties.

You will also be able to select a fitting playstyle at the start of the game. By now, the settings were running out of hand, so we cleaned it up a bit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/ab8e34ad71ff7c200a253d9c7f3bb4c31bbcb07c.png[/img]

Hopefully these changes will keep the game fresh and exciting for all you giants! And if you're wondering when this rework update will arrive, you will soon have your answer as our Roadmap is finalized and will be shared in the coming days! We're looking forward to all the new combinations you come up with! 

- Greetings from Adriaan & the other monks

notes.title: Ice Age DLC Content and Winter sales
notes.content:
Hey Giants!

Our next Major Update bringing disasters abilites and relationships is not coming alone: do you wish for a new biome? More biotica? More leaders? More Eras? Here comes [b]the Ice Age DLC[/b]! 

Our goal has always been to make the game the most satisfying for all Reus 2 players, from the “casual once in a while” players to the “hardcore high scores and achievements seeker” ones. We have plenty of ideas for Reus 2, and we’ve listened to your ideas as well. Even if not all of these ideas can be brought to the game, we still want to make the most of it, and our best solution is through a paid DLC that will support future free updates.

This DLC aims to implement new content in the game on different levels, from the new biome to new leaders, era options, and biotica. All of these will support new strategies and stories for your planets. We just wanted to be as transparent as possible with you about this.

Before diving into the content of the DLC, know that the Winter sales on Steam begin today with a [b]33% discount[/b] on the main game and[b] 10% on the Supporter Pack[/b]! Could be a great Christmas gift for your loved ones, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/e96818c6e47b377d639e5fa2630560bc244fe48a.png[/img]
[h3]New biome, the Ice Age biome:[/h3]

Like the Taiga biome, it can be placed by the Frost Giant if you toggle it to the Ice Age mode instead of the Taiga mode at the start of your planet. This new biome also gives a whole new look to Aegir the Frost Giant!

A whole new biome also means a full new set of unique Apex and Cohort biotica, as well as gameplay mechanics. From animals to plants and minerals, you’ll discover a whole new bunch of biotica on the Ice Age theme like the Smilodon, Permafrost, Geyser, and the iconic Mammoth! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/14e219d61992ffea4badf1688bcde0826112f036.gif[/img]

This new biome plays with themes of evolution and extinction, giving new tags like “extinct” to the biotica. These new evolution and extinction mechanics give you unique new ways to unlock and power up biotica through the eras.

[h3]4 New Leaders:[/h3]

Each leader brings a new perspective for your cities and are inspired by real-life personalities as well as archetypes the community suggested! You can guess who inspired who in the comments of this Steam News!
[list]
[*] The General: he gets a bonus for the new military Power stat coming with the free Cataclysm Update
[*] The Poet: a leader who improves projects
[*] The Villain: this leader thrives with hate on the world
[*] The Painter: she sees the world as her canvas and needs a colorful world to express herself (as well as gold)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/0b9d8aad0ac839af026a1ec3e72eaf9df90a4d8c.png[/img]
[h3]More turning points:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nuclear War Age: Will Humanity become Death, the destroyer of Worlds?
[*] Hunter Age: Winter is coming, will your planet survive it?
[*] Age of Discovery: Some things are just so pretty, they belong in a museum!
[*] Age of Enlightenment: If something does not exist, invent it!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/a867f798bd15b520e38b26a4b43dc431fac6bf53.png[/img]
This paid DLC will cost[b] 7.99 USD / 7.79 Euros / 6.69£[/b] and will be released on [b]January 16th, 2025[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333960/Reus_2__Ice_Age/

🌪️ Want to know more about the Cataclysm Update content? Read our dedicated Steam News here:

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1875060/announcements/detail/564735827901415450

We will be on holiday break at the end of December but we will be back soon with new content as a belated Christmas present. Enjoy the holidays and the end of the year, from the whole team, best wishes and we can’t wait to begin 2025 by your side!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/6fda012e18d716bf3976dc1779d7088b6fef8452.png[/img]

notes.title: Cataclysm and Relationships will arrive in Reus 2
notes.content:
Hey Giants!

We have already teased you that the next update will bring a new side to Reus 2. For the players who missed the chaos and excitement humanity can birth, this Update is for you! Let’s take a look at the new features the Cataclysm update will bring!

[h3][b]Humans and Giants relations:[/b][/h3]

Leaders will now develop relationships with each other and giants. These relationships can be positive or negative, and leaders will have preferences based on their personalities. The Goddess, for example, likes leaders with little wealth so she can stay the richest person around. Relationships with giants depend on how well you help them with their requests.
[list]
[*] If a leader [b]likes[/b] another leader, they might start a cultural exchange program, or a special invention. If they like a giant, they might built a little temple in their honor!
[*] However, if leaders become [b]enemies[/b], they might start wars to steal each other’s resources. If they hate a giant, they might decide the giant is no longer welcome or try to hunt them down.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/13c8f8d0190a6cc3e2dd06da28b0c6967ab9e02a.png[/img]
All interactions except hateful actions against the giants are a net positive for your planet: humanity also learns and develops through strife. You can control who will benefit, though!

[h3][b]Toy with forces of nature:[/b][/h3]

If the humans decide to cause chaos, you don’t have to stand by idly! Giants can retaliate or control the outcome of conflicts with their own [b]Disaster Abilities[/b]! Each Giant has a disaster ability that targets a small area and hits cities and any envoys (armies, border expanders, trade missions) in the area.
[list]
[*] Ocean Giant: Tsunami, which requires the City to be close to a 5 tiles range of an Ocean biome
[*] Forest Giant: Tornado 
[*] Savannah Giant: Wildfire
[*] Frost Giant: Blizzard
[*] Swamp Giant: Bog
[*] Rock Giant: Earthquake
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/c2313203b183a1d585b41c7e1f95ce360dbcb282.gif[/img]

To conclude on this future update, there are two main things to remember about this update: disasters are a tool [b]you may or may not use[/b] and conflicts are [b]optional[/b]. There will be relationships between cities and Giants however the game will never force you to wield the giants' disaster abilities or attack a group of pesky humans if you wish to have peaceful gameplay. The update is meant to bring more liveliness and personality to your planets, without distracting you from playing the game at your own pace. Enable it as you see fit! 

Remember that we are also working on our first DLC that you can already wishlist here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333960/Reus_2__Ice_Age/

[h3][b]Upcoming showcase, the Game Awards (sort of):[/b][/h3]

We’re thrilled to announce that Reus 2 has been selected to be part of [b]The Game Awards for Games Who Can’t Afford the Game Awards (TGAGWCAGA) 2024 Showcase[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/3391a7561e464dbdf78bb46ed16b5e889115c5e0.png[/img]
TGAGWCAGA is a brand new showcase designed to spotlight incredible indie games that truly deserve more attention—while also poking a bit of fun at the exclusivity of The Game Awards.

The show starts on [b]Friday, December 13th[/b] at 5:00 PM UTC / 6:00 PM CET / 12:00 PM ET!

Subscribe to the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@TGAGWCAGA]YouTube channel[/url] and don’t miss it!

Also a huge thank you for all your messages about the Steam Awards nomination and your amazing reviews that kept coming in the last few days. We are super grateful for your unconditional support!

Stay tuned for the Update that will make its chaotic entrance into the world of Reus 2 at the start of next year, and you will also soon learn more about the DLC.

-Adriaan and the Monks at the Abbey

notes.content:
Hello Giants,

August is nearly finished and we are part of the Back-To-School event on Steam. This celebration aims to highlight games that have an educational approach and that help people learn about different domains or facts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/946096f2072066cd62888802e51c2c98b2cf9f26.png[/img]

For this special event, we also wanted to bring back something we started months ago, even before the game release:[b] the biotica facts sheet[/b]! We want you to be part of Reus 2's creation through this [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ShQsECRw_wzvyagz1QRGw_-U87wlfK1MFHza9Q0kr8k/edit?usp=sharing]Google sheet[/url] with all the biotica available in the game. Some biotica still do not have facts on them and await your input! We will choose among your suggestions to implement your facts in the game. Ask your friends to share facts if they have some! Know that there are some rules for this Google Sheet:
[list]
[*] You can write 1 to 3 facts in total per person, and if you previously wrote the first time, you can again write 3 more facts!
[*] Your fact must be 200 characters long maximum
[*] Don’t forget to also write your name in the right column so you can be credited
[*] You have until [b]Monday 16th of September[/b] to submit your facts
[*] It can be a fun fact, a serious one, a weird one but please try to avoid any mean/problematic facts
[*] And last: HAVE FUN FOR THE GIANTS SAKE!
[/list]
Nature and its amazing wildlife is at the heart of Reus 2: through the biotica, we wanted to highlight what makes our environment such an interesting place to live and nurture! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/f1fab0fb9f2b790ccd50ccbf0a21f17a12f71bd5.gif[/img]

Each bioticum has its own effects and features which makes them both unique and essential into the complex ecosystem that is nature. The symbiosis in Reus 2 is also a major aspect that emphasizes the link which can be create between animals, plants and minerals and how these bonds give birth to something totally new!

Stay tuned for the next announcements and upcoming updates!

notes.title: Major Update: Great Barrier Reef Update and TactiCon begins!
notes.content:
Hello Giants!

Summer is here as well as our second Milestone! Localization in German, French, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese, new challenge options and more content for the Ocean biome… We can’t wait for you to dive into these new additions!

We are also overjoyed to be part of Tacticon this year, among many great strategy games! The game will be [b]on sale (20% off)[/b], and I am doing[b] a dev talk[/b] about God Games and Reus 2, more info on the TactiCon Steam page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/13a929b8ab268fa0d50bd0fb06d02a59572b6f1e.png[/img]
The Great Barrier Reef is the world’s largest coral reef system, this you probably already know, but did you know that over[b] 2,900 individual reefs and 900 islands [/b]are part of this system? It is also visible from space! According to a study in October 2012, the reef has lost more than half its coral cover since 1985, and this number only grows as coral bleaching has not yet been quantified!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/949d7332066a24882277850d670f929897509f10.jpg[/img]
[i]Credits: "The Great Barrier Reef outlines the coast of Australia in turquoise and blue. The #StoryOfWater." - Kjell Lindgren[/i]

Let’s deep dive into the new content of the update (and as usual you can find the detailed Patch Notes at the end of this Steam News)!

[h3]New Localization[/h3]

We’re adding [b]4 new languages[/b]! From now on, you can play Reus 2 in [b]German, French, Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish[/b]! As these translations are freshly baked, we want to warn you about a few texts and interface descriptions are unperfect and will need to be improved. We'll be working on them in the coming days to make it perfect! Feel free to share your feedback on the languages in the dedicated channels in our Discord or in the Steam Discussions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/fa2cc7ef7548999c4e7938c2cdb4b3b9b3a01528.png[/img]
[i]Asset inspired by the French Rock Giant Damien shared by our community member orian34 on Discord.[/i]

[h3]New Options, Giant Trial[/h3]

Originally, we wanted to create a challenge editor, but that proved too challenging (heh) for the time we had. Instead, we created some new options for you to play with, and the Giant Trial, which sets the game to a more roguelite experience.

[list]
[*] [b]No Free Rerolls:[/b] You will start with 2 rerolls, but won’t gain any extra free rerolls. Are you creative enough to make builds on the spot?
[*] [b]Max Drafts per Biome:[/b] Change the maximum drafts per biome to 4 or 5, forcing you to really think about what build you want to create. Can you craft the best builds out of all possibilities?
[*] [b]Titan Trial: [/b]This sets the game to Challenge, Max Drafts 4, No Free Rerolls & Horizon Draft, and the difficulty to at least “Giant”. A true challenge of creativity and knowledge of Reus 2, where you will have to make tough decisions and can’t have it all. Are you up for the challenge of your new planet?
[/list]
The game will be balanced around these settings, although you’re always welcome to make beautiful or busted planets with 12 Forest Drafts!

[h3]Bonus Ocean content Update[/h3]

For the Great Barrier Reef update, we got some nice new Ocean Biotica for you to play with! The Ocean was a bit too lacking for our taste, so we decided to give some [b]new options for free[/b]. Another major change is that Create Creek now also creates a Stream under water, and Sanctuary also works in the Ocean!

We also made a number of smaller changes and requested fixes. You can see all the changes in the log below! 

Let your strategy speak for you and enjoy both the Update and TactiCon!

See you soon!

- Adriaan and the monks of the Abbey

notes.title: 5 tips to start
notes.content:
Greetings, Mighty Shaper of Worlds,

Welcome to the expansive and wondrous universe of Reus 2, where you wield the power to shape planets and influence the delicate balance of life. As the universe itself, I have observed countless worlds take form and evolve under the guidance of entities like yourself. Here are five essential tips and tricks to help you on your journey of creation and stewardship, particularly focusing on those fascinating beings known as humans who now inhabit your world.

[h3]1. Harness the Power of Human Spirits[/h3]

At the dawn of your planetary creation, you are presented with the choice of a Human Spirit. These spirits imbue your world with unique buffs that extend beyond the initial settlement, enhancing the entire planet. The spirit you select is more than a mere starting boon; it is a pervasive influence that can shape the trajectory of your planet’s development. Choose wisely, as the spirit's benefits can significantly bolster your efforts across various regions and settlements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/06da3629ba0e4300a601a3f415093c5ae37209dc.jpg[/img]
[h3]2. Master the Art of Nodes and Boosted Nodes[/h3]

Nodes are pivotal in the allocation of resources and the expansion of your settlements. Placing a node within your borders immediately grants you its resources, but placing it just outside will pique the interest of your villagers, prompting expansion. This strategic placement can yield delayed, but substantial, benefits once your borders encompass the node.

Moreover, nodes with boosts—known as boosted nodes—are particularly valuable. By placing biotica on these nodes, you can not only increase resource yield but also stimulate your humans' creativity and industriousness, leading to the invention of new tools and technologies. Inventions derived from boosted nodes can be traded between settlements, provided they have achieved sufficient wealth, offering a significant boost to your world’s progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/e7efee0c476a729690a97da6be7df4f164292469.jpg[/img]
[h3]3. Unlock the Secrets of Symbiosis[/h3]

Symbiosis is a cornerstone of effective biotica management in Reus 2. This principle revolves around the harmonious interactions between different biotica, enhancing resource yields through strategic placement. For example, placing a pit viper biotica, which grants 5 Wealth, next to a critter biotica can activate a synergy that provides an additional +15 Wealth. Such combinations are the key to maximizing the potential of your planet’s resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/52ebaa43ac9da0c1a6eb5e37b3e3f3ca8b92b96e.jpg[/img]
[h3]4. Engage in Quests and Unlock Drafts[/h3]

Each settlement will present you with quests shortly after a nomad has established it. Completing these quests is crucial, as they unlock drafts. Drafts are essential tools for acquiring new and advanced bioticas, allowing you to further customize and optimize your biomes. By diligently fulfilling quests, you gain access to a broader array of bioticas, enhancing your ability to create a thriving and diverse planetary ecosystem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/7b5052cbb8f8c3faf81dc7658a16f407ed340ba9.png[/img]
[h3]5. Embrace Metaprogression and Experimentation[/h3]

With over 200 bioticas at your disposal, the possibilities for experimentation and discovery are virtually limitless. The rating of your completed planet influences how quickly you unlock new bioticas and game features, encouraging you to explore different combinations and strategies. Each run offers a fresh opportunity to experiment with new biomes, giants, and bioticas, leading to unique outcomes and insights. This iterative process of experimentation and metaprogression ensures that every planet you create is a step towards mastering the art of world-building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/048f9a293100bdcf23b18c79aa94ba0af2022c53.jpg[/img]
[h3]Do you prefer a video format? Watch the 5 tips to start on Youtube![/h3]
[previewyoutube=6TTP-tohMc4;full][/previewyoutube]
With these tips, mighty entity, you are well-equipped to guide your humans and shape your planet with wisdom and creativity. May your journey be filled with discovery and the joy of creation.

- The Universe -

notes.title: Meet all the Giants!
notes.content:
Hello Titans,

They are as iconic to Reus as the sun in the sky, we are talking about [b]the giants[/b] of course! After 11 years, they are back with new designs and mechanics, as well as exclusive new ones that were absent from Reus!

Every giant has a primary Biome they excel in, a secondary Biome that they unlock later. They also have an affinity that is reflected in small details of their abilities. The good humans in the Discord community (Join [url=https://discord.gg/EANmk2rbVG]HERE[/url]!) have given the giants their human name; the name by which they are known by the little humans of Reus. The titans themselves didn’t even need names before humans could call for their help!

[h2]Satari, the Forest Giant[/h2]
[list]
[*] Primary Biome: Forest
[*] Secondary Biome: Rainforest
[*] Affinity: Plants
[/list]
With his moss fur, Satari's design changed a lot since his first iteration and his name means "the one who plants" in Aymara. The Forest Biome is the most balanced of all biomes, even rewarding you for using a bit of everything!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/346beb160156b0c5956b3076ad7ad508f9a706a3.gif[/img]

[h2]Khiton, the Ocean Giant[/h2]
[list]
[*] Primary Biome: Ocean
[*] Secondary Biome: Forest
[*] Affinity: Animals
[/list]
Named after the crab's shell, Khiton is ready to make waves and add more blue to the planet. The Ocean Biome has a reef and a deep part, as long as the ocean is big enough! It is also full of mystery; a resource whose value depends on the one who finds it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/5555bd55508953dce665cda124aeb52fb2ed7741.gif[/img]

[h2]Atlas, the Rock Giant[/h2]
[list]
[*] Primary Biome: Desert
[*] Secondary Biome: Taiga
[*] Affinity: Minerals and Valuables
[/list]
His punches are memorable and his strength is mighty, Atlas has a name fitting the burden of his stature. The Desert is a desolate place with few plants. However, it rewards you for playing spaciously and has hidden mineral treasures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/3ad4c2813349072c1d75c8f5152bfc02fe72f202.gif[/img]

[h2]Aegir, the Taiga Giant[/h2]
[list]
[*] Primary Biome: Taiga
[*] Secondary Biome: Ocean
[*] Affinity: Minerals and Science
[/list]
His beard made of stalactites seems to reflect its ancient nature and he never gets cold feet about breaking the ice with the humans. The Taiga motivates you to make it dangerous and inhospitable, or to make it huge and create big distances between cities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/0f771881a85bb7ac287c32a4fc5047ff02e80282.gif[/img]

[h2]Reginald, the Swamp Giant[/h2]
[list]
[*] Primary Biome: Rainforest
[*] Secondary Biome: Savanna
[*] Affinity: Plants and Diversity
[/list]
How could we resist that little frog-like face? Reginald loves that many humans are named after him. Gaining a redesign from Reus 1, he also loses the swamp for the Rainforest. Is he even a Swamp giant, one could ask! The Rainforest excels with great biodiversity! Place as many distinct biotica as you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/a077e108ae154715cda2bff072171024c5b0a48b.gif[/img]

[h2]Jangwa, the Savannah Giant[/h2]
[list]
[*] Primary Biome: Savanna
[*] Secondary Biome: Desert
[*] Affinity: Animals and Predators
[/list]
Let's be honest, we all want to pet Jangwa! His name means "desert" in Swahili; the community wanted to pay tribute to the Lion King and how could we refuse such a great idea? The Savannah Biome is full of exciting animals and rewards you for making harmonic sets. Is your Savannah going to host a herd of herbivores, dangerous predators, or are you going to collect the Ugly 5?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/04015af149accb9e3b32a1790e2679eb05cfb567.gif[/img]

Every giant has their own set of terraform and biome abilities. Additionally, they can [b]upgrade Biotica[/b] in their own way. Plants tended by the Swamp giant can have different accents than those tended by the Forest Giant!

A planet can only support 3 of these titans at the same time. So go out there and combine them to create your perfect worlds!

notes.title: Reus 2 vs Reus
notes.content:
Hello giants,

You might have looked at Reus 2 and thought: "What is the difference with the original Reus?" With Reus 2 releasing within weeks, it's a good moment to compare it with the original and highlight the many improvements we made! 


In short:
[table equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [th]Reus 2[/th]
        [th]Reus [/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Game moves with your actions [/td]
        [td]timer and real-time pressure[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
       [td]Simple grid on the planet [/td]
        [td] Single-line gameplay[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Biome and Tag symbiosis [/td]
        [td]named Symbiosis[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Biome Drafts[/td]
        [td]Confusing leveling scheme[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
       [td]Peaceful Experience[/td]
        [td]very annoying humans[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]6 Biomes, 250+ unique Biotica [/td]
        [td]4+ Biomes, 100+ Biotica[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Human Eras[/td]
        [td][i]Nothing[/i][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
 And more!

[h2]1. Play at your pace[/h2]
The first thing you'll notice is the [b]pace[/b] of the game. Instead of having to worry about each second, Eon [i](representing time)[/i] only moves forward when you place Biotica [i](e.g. Plants, Animals, Minerals)[/i]. Your goal is not to reach your goals within a timespan but with a set number of Eon. Having more cities on your planet will give you a higher Eon limit and more actions.

This means no more need to press the space bar to pause the game with each action or be afraid to take a break. Don't worry about replacing things either: Replacement only costs 1/5 of the actions that a new placement costs.

This makes the game adapt to your speed of play: You're the master of the universe and time after all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/fbc5003a28f9c192addece75148e8fd806cd4f3e.png[/img]

[h2]2. Grid on the Planet[/h2]
Another immediately noticeable change is the grid on the planet. Instead of playing on a single line, there is a small hex grid. This means that most slots will have 4 neighbors instead of only 2, vastly increasing your options and strategies.

There are even ways to expand the grid. Place a Mountain to add three slots on top, or expand the planet to have more room for your Biotica.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/a9e03c20ff04466fab8580dde1c9bb9f94a3c4b5.gif[/img]

[h2]3. Biome & Tag Symbioses[/h2]
The original Reus had symbioses based on names, for example: "next to a Chicken." Reus 2 is very different; instead, it uses tags like "bird" or "tree". This gives you much more freedom to create your ecosystem.

Another addition is the concept of Biome-wide Symbioses. These will trigger on Biotica as long as they are in the same Desert, Forest, or other Biome. There have never been so many options and combos to make!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/7640150b936be3d06f674fd606fcc548cca41fee.png[/img]

[h2]4. Biotica Drafts[/h2]
Instead of having to memorize an arcane web where errors would mean restarts, Biotica now unlock through drafts. You will earn these drafts by helping humans as usual. But then you can use them to unlock a set of Biotica for one specific Biome. Your options will be semi-random. You can use rerolls however to search for that Tiger you want so badly.

This way, no game will be the same, but it will be much easier to make decisions on what you want next! An added benefit is that all combinations of Biotica are now also possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/36bdf11f06ccfba6b563938ffeb4dfd06d38ce48.png[/img]
[h2]5. A peaceful Experience[/h2]
War and giant hunting were never a fan favorite of Reus players, even though the fantasy is cool. We decided to remove these features from Reus 2 altogether until we know how to add them in a way that fits well with the rest of the game. This needs a lot more work, or else we will just end up with the same nuisances as in the original.

Enjoy your peaceful time on your planets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/57925c6d5e55dcef24242b81628e8074ff44309c.gif[/img]

[h2]6. Much more content[/h2]
We more than doubled the content for Reus 2! I'm not going to spoil all there is to find, just know there are unlimited possibilities and configurations on how to create your perfect planet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/5e5ffa45fb2908ec0a389b8a74e577b7469d0932.gif[/img]

[h2]7. Human Eras[/h2]
Instead of playing games of 30 minutes to 2 hours, in Reus 2 you will go from Era to era. There are up to 3 Eras per planet. Every Era has its own vibe and goals. Will you help humans go to space, or will you support their revolution? Do well on the goals and you'll be rewarded with a little happening!

Your achievements will also be tied to which Eras you've completed. Try to get 3 stars on all of them and see all that humanity has to offer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/e47bd2bcd9337af77ffd2518809a371592f9561d.png[/img]

And we have much more! Planets in space, unique mechanics per biome, characters, and more improvements! We hope you will find all the content and mechanics the game has to offer, and enjoy your time to create a universe full of life!

We can't wait to see what you make!
Adriaan and the Monks at the Abbey

notes.title: Earth Appreciation Festival: Nature & Humanity in Reus 2
notes.content:
We are excited to be part of the [b]Earth Appreciation Festival[/b] with a [b]demo[/b] on Steam as nature plays a huge part in our game! 

Popular belief might think that god games are an escape route for us to destroy things, and let our rage and power break the world like a kid would with a Lego tower… However, even if you may let chaos speak in Reus 2, our main goal was to show the beauty of life and how life is all about collaboration.

[h2]One can not live without the other[/h2]

Reus is by no means a nature-first simulation. In the end, people who care about nature are a rare vintage. These nature lovers are the people who know birds by their beaks or have studied barnacle reproductive lives for their living. Most people care about nature through the relationship it has with themselves. This is not a negative aspect: they enjoy beautiful things nature produces, they like the calm of it, or they feel dependent on it. A real nature simulator is therefore fundamentally disinteresting to them.
In Reus 1, the focus was more nature-oriented but as one IGN reviewer put it: [i]"I don't care about the Ginkgo tree"[/i]. (we got a 6 from them). In Reus 2, we try to [b]elevate the humans[/b] in the equation. This influences everything in this new Reus.

[h2]Nature gives (and Humans sort of give back)[/h2]

In Reus, you create [b]harmonious ecosystems[/b] to help humanity forward. This has a thick layer of fantasy because this is different from how humanity interacts with nature in real life as we know it. The most biodiverse places are often devoid of humans and humans actively try to create places of low biodiversity, much to their benefit. We hate parasites, vermin, weeds, scavengers, pest carriers, and predators around us despite them being a vital part of nature.

In a larger sense, we can say we need a healthy nature for our own good, so we take shortcuts to illustrate that. For example, a hyena by itself is never going to be of much value to humanity. But as part of an ecosystem, they keep things stable. For the sake of a fun and diverse game, we put a reward tag on the hyena: they are directly valuable to humanity in the game.
To complete the loop, we say that humanity adds spirit and creativity to the planet. And that itself is valuable to the universe!
We wanted to have a very specific place for humanity in Reus 2. They are special and at the heart of what you seek. But they're just as puny as all the other things you create. And [b]no group is above the other![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/94c247219416f80bcb413f9129399314a4618851.gif[/img]

[h2]Symbiosis[/h2]

Symbioses are representations of how nature works together and keeps things in check. The fox does better with rabbits to eat around it. Plants enjoy being close to a river. Since we focus on the relationship with humanity and a fun strategic game, we have to get a bit creative sometimes.
For example, ores and minerals are a vital part of the [b]human-nature relationship[/b] but ores are not organic, so they can't "fare better". In that case, we take things differently and more straightforwardly: rocks are a part of a beautiful natural garden, and iron is a heavy metal, prone to overexploitation.

Every giant is designed with [b]two biomes[/b] and affinity in mind. It is shown by their colors, the small vegetation or life on and around them, and of course the nature of their design! Often, the design already implies their affinity: the ocean is mostly used for its animals, so the ocean giant gets that affinity! But in truth, if you truly think about it, every combination should be possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/60f6abf4ea38fa85b6432abceb697dfb53a6a448.jpg[/img]

We have to strike [b]a balance[/b]: there must be enough of each type. Minerals are chosen based on their usefulness, as are most plants. But animals are picked by how cool they are, and we're happy to take a shortcut. We don't care that there is no such thing as a Marabou farm, that bird is awesome!

That’s it for today’s dev journal, we hope you learned more about our vision of nature and humanity working together! Enjoy the event on Steam and we will be back with more news in the days to come!

Share your feedback on the demo in our [url=https://discord.com/channels/1104056458624118854/1104080210632118393/1106273704129867926]Discord[/url]!

- Adriaan and the Monks at the Abbey

notes.title: Dev Journal: The Eras
notes.content:
If you've played the demo, you might have noticed a moment in which you would choose your [b]next Era.[/b] This feature was very basic back then. But now, the Eras have evolved and taken their space in Reus 2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/811f4ba44948b5086886e989c048fbe617ed68f9.gif[/img]

[h2]Guide humanity[/h2]
As time progresses with any of your actions, so does humanity. If you develop enough, you will enter a new Era however you may wonder which Era? It is up to you! Your options depend on how far you are in the game. Once you unlock more of the game, you can pick between different [b]3 Eras[/b]:
[olist]
[*] One Ancient Era.
[*] One Medieval Era.
[*] One Discovery Era.
[/olist]
The Eras you can select also depends on what your planet looks like!

[h2]Gameplay Effects[/h2]
Each Era has a unique aspect, but also a unique -if optional- Challenger Quest. Reaching these goals can be quite challenging, and you might have to plan your strategy in advance to complete the harder goals. 

An example is the [b]Castle Age[/b]. This Medieval Era will need 3 cities, which will all want to grow in different directions. Each will build their own castle with a personal effect and your goal is to make them all reach their personal ambition. Not only are they needy, they are also quite jealous! Help a city too often, and the others will hold a grudge against you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/764df61be99ae3d14d70cc3060e23a85f3840521.png[/img]
The Challenger Quests is a [b]stretch goal[/b] for your planet, and you can progress regardless of whether you complete it or not. If you clear the Challenger Quest, you will be rewarded with extras unlocks, resources and a little cinematic for conclusion of the Era! Can you balance their needs without turning them against you?

[h2]Humanity is Crazy[/h2]
This Castle Age is an example of an Era that seems mundane however for Reus 2, we wanted humanity to go where it has always dreamt it could go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/de70463ee5e76eb77a524454516d63dfa68327fd.png[/img]
So who knows what kind of ending you might find for humanity? There is an endless stream of ideas we got from the community, so we hope to keep making Reus 2 Eras for a long time!

- Greetings from Adriaan and the Monks at the Abbey

notes.title: Dev Journal: Demo Conclusions
notes.content:
With the Steam Next Fest behind us, we would want to reflect on how things went. We're happy with the demo, but there are certainly some things we could improve. Let's take a look at it!

[h2]Replayability[/h2]
We're happy to see the core of the game working so well! The average play time for the demo is [b]45 minutes.[/b] That is pretty impressive for a demo! The spread is big: there is a group of 27% that doesn't even get to 5 minutes. Probably people who try it out quickly and it just isn't their thing. Over 1000 players have played the demo for more than 2 hours! It was a bit surprising for us, given the limited content.

But it can get even better! On Discord, we've already seen people playing over 20 hours of the demo. They've been trying hard to find all the best options and combinations to go above and beyond 3 stars for a Turning Point!

The player [b]NoBanana[/b] even managed to get this amazing score.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/ea7ba5050befbe89bab1a843d3905fbd138daa33.png[/img]
[i]The Ostrich seems to be the route to high scores in the demo![/i]

[b]Conclusion:[/b] We think we're on the right track here and just need to make more content!


[h2]Visuals & Stability[/h2]
Here we think we could do even better. We had plenty of bug reports, and we got our work cut out in front of us! Also, visually we feel we've been doing good, but could be doing great. One thing that we've been missing a lot is a [b]Snow Biome[/b]. We absolutely agreed, and decided to give the Taiga a little makeover too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/9c56f98fa7cb8a4d3f2de00b4bcd2a6745747c4e.png[/img]
[i]A crispy cold day in the world of Reus.[/i]

To complement this, we've also changed the base rules for the Taiga: it will be a biome that allows you to play with the distance towards the nearest city and has a unique Rugged mechanic: the more inhospitable the Taiga is with predators and minerals, the more value the humans can find there!

[b]Conclusion[/b]: There is still a lot of polishing work to do!


[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
In general, we're quite happy with the gameplay. We wish to expand further on Projects, Requests, Inventions, and Turning Points. We're planning on each planet having 3 turning points, increasing in size as the game progresses! Maybe you've already seen the rocket in the trailer?

Besides that, we have 2 new exciting improvements waiting for you:
[list]
[*] [b]Rewarding Resources:[/b] We found Reus 2 to be a bit too rigid, and found a good way to counteract that. In the future, you will get resources for reaching planet milestones. These resources include bonus Eon and mountain charges. Every resource has a different focus!
[*] [b]Microbiotica:[/b] As mentioned by some players, the Aspects fall a bit flat. Instead, you can now use a Micro charge to create a set of [b]Microbiotica[/b]. Think of bugs, fungi, or other small organisms! These are random, and can therefore be a lot more powerful! Every giant will have their guaranteed unique Microbiotica though!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/7f4002ce51ee8b45a055ad27b2592e5b47ec1d53.png[/img]
[i]An example of what you could get with Wealth on your planet.[/i]


[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
It's clear by the demo that we're in a good place! We have some minor improvements to do on the game, but it's mostly balancing, content and polishing! We're working hard on these as we speak, and hope to make the planet building as enjoyable as possible for you all!

Adriaan and the monks at the Abbey

notes.title: Dev Journal: Playtest Report
notes.content:
In December, we organized a playtest to prepare ourselves for the big jumps ahead. Over 800 of you played Reus 2, which is a great number for us! It was a pretty rough version, but even so, there was a lot of interesting stuff we collected! Let's go over some facts!


[h3]We got almost 200 survey answers[/h3]
This surprised all of us! 1/4 of all players giving constructive feedback is much more than we're used to seeing! Some wrote paragraphs of text, while others were more concise. On top of that, there were many good discussions on the Reus 2 Discord. So from the whole team; thank you very much for the feedback!

[b]Conclusion[/b]: You are dedicated to see Reus 2 live up to its potential! Exciting!


[h3]The median playtime was 36 minutes[/h3]
Half of the players played more, and half of the players played less than 36 minutes. This was a positive for us because the demo was lower. The average was even higher: 1 hour and 46 minutes! Wow! There are already over 1400 hours of Reus 2 played! These are great numbers for us, because the game is far from finished and missing 80% of the content. The game is fun, even when there is no progression. Many planets were created:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/6036177f2a26836e084bb10a2e3bfec9ba5009e2.gif[/img]

The playrange had something worrying though: 15% off all players didn't play more than 6 minutes. We got some work to do in making a smooth entrance, although we first want to make sure that the game is super replayable and fun for those who got into it quickly. No need to streamline it into oblivion.

[b]Conclusion:[/b] The game is turning out to be very replayable, but we got work to do on the start.


[h3]We experimented with different goals[/h3]
Talking about streamlining: we experimented with different goals for the game. This time, instead of getting the most out of your Eon like in the demo, you had to complete a set goal. This made it easier to explain to new players. However, veterans disliked this new system, and for a good reason.

Instead of winning by making the most out of the planet, you won by achieving the goal the most efficient way. The less biotica you placed, the higher the score. But Reus 2 is about bringing life, not scraping by!

[b]Conclusion:[/b] We returned the highscore aspect of the game.


[h3]8% of the people did not play the original Reus[/h3]
This one is important to us! If we want Reus 2 to succeed, we need to have a lot of people enjoying the game. 8% is still low. We're not worried though, because we believe that with a good game the existing fanbase will carry it forward! We make the game for Reus fans first, and if that rocks, the rest will surely come!

[b]Conclusion:[/b] We're not appealing much to non-Reus fans... yet!

[h2]New features on the Horizon[/h2]
All in all, we learned a lot from all the feedback you gave us. We already changed some important things, and more features are coming. We also didn't talk about the many new things added to the game, but we'll leave that for a next time!

Hope to see you soon!
- Adriaan and the monks from the Abbey

notes.title: Dev Journal: Biodiversity
notes.content:
Reus is a game about the connection between nature and humanity. Some of these relationships are obvious. People found some wild cereals, domesticated and planted them in farms, and 600 years later we have cornflakes. But as other links are not so obvious...

[h2]Biodiversity[/h2]
Enter [b]biodiversity[/b]. A hot topic nowadays for sure! Since we wanted to have many different biotica and encourage the player to try different setups, biodiversity seemed like a great topic to turn into a game mechanic! 
What does biodiversity do for humanity? As we researched the topic, the answer was not so obvious. Humans have thrived in places with relatively low biodiversity, like arid subtropical regions or colder plains. While rainforests, easily the most biodiverse places on our spiff little planet, have commonly made it hard for us to develop. Biodiversity also means more different pathogens and parasites to take care off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/86a42f5b1783294b116c97ac33beedd1cf99b4e3.png[/img]
[i]Nature around Abbey Games. Pretty, but not the epitomy of biodivserity.[/i]

But biodiversity also creates new opportunities and keeps ecosystems stable. New plants like coffee or cacao that only exists in spefic niches. Biodiversity allows for more specialization and ecological stability.


[h2]Apex Biotica[/h2]
In Reus 2, biodiversity plays a support role. Every unique bioticum you place in a Biome, will raise it by 1. Some biotica have symbioses that give even more biodiversity. They are more useful to nature than humanity, so their yields are often quite low!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/9da91c907e991e6161f6f75d8e137afa993964bb.gif[/img]
[i]Biodiversity in the top. Every instance of a biome has its own biodiversity.[/i] 

Basically, Biodiversity is an upkeep for the stronger, more special biotica. Other biotica, especially the [b]Apex Biotica[/b], use this biodiversity. The stronger the biotica, the more biodiversity it will need. The Lapis Lazuli for example is a powerful desert Mineral that benefits greatly from gems around it. It does need 5 Biodiversity to be active though!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/9d18ab0c1580d53e49d1f5159a922bba4ad12069.png[/img]
[i]The Lapis Lazuli, famously used by ancient Egyptians in many of their jewelry[/i]


[h2]Rainforest[/h2]
But not all biomes use Biodiversity in the same way! The new [b]Rainforest[/b] biome has a different take. The Apex biotica are cheaper, and there are more biotica that give bonus Biodiversity. However, many biotica scale on how much extra Biodiversity is avaliable! Take the Gumbo-Limbo, which gives more Science for bonus Biodiversity.

In the rainforest, you might want to maximize that Biodiversity instead of using it all up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/3b1784422330765fcf72a5856fd16cc4af27485d.png[/img]
[i]The Gumbo-Limbo is a useful tree for the ecology, and very hurricane resistant to boot![/i]


Biodiversity makes its entry into Reus 2 as a new mechanic. More than before, you will have to keep an eye to what you place. Spamming the same biotica combo over and over might no longer be the best way forward!
Looking forward to play? Let us know in the comments or on our [url=https://discord.gg/WWAY2QZ8pP]Discord[/url]!


- Adriaan and the Monks at the Abbey

notes.title: Dev Journal: Personalities
notes.content:
Hello mighty giants!

This week, I would love to talk about something new in Reus 2: [b]Personalities[/b]! We'll talk about why this has been added, what it will mean for your planet, and introduce you to a few!


[h2]Why are the humans here?[/h2]
In the original Reus, humans were... kind of boring. Let's be honest. They settled in a location of your liking, sometimes went to war, but not much more. Their only expression was which project they started, and even that was limited and random.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/f7ea660a8f2a317677d69d14603437baf5cfaee0.png[/img]
[i]Ok, and they did like celebrating in poop.[/i]

There was much room for improvement here, so we tried to make the most of it!


[h2]Personalities[/h2]
In [b]Reus 2[/b] every nomad or city will carry a personality. This is not only a fancy portrait of their leader, but it also shows what kind of little sentient meat bags you have running around on your planet. For example, it matters little where they settle for their projects. Instead, a combination of their character and surroundings will determine the options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/22c123991aa67fb860933e8037dc5bb3c3b6c829.png[/img]
[i]These Scholars nomads want to see many different things![/i]

Secondly, personalities that you help will paint the way forward. If you played the demo, you might've seen the [b]Turning Points[/b] for a new Era. Well, those will be unlocked depending on the personalities you help. The favored will paint the future!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/14a534a82a29a763dfd1d831e6c3e5a5eeadfb39.png[/img]
[i]One of the Classic Turning Points: The Age of Monuments![/i]

Another, very important new aspect of Reus 2, is that personalities have [b]Ambitions[/b]. When you create a new planet, you will pick the personality you would like to help the most. They will set the goal for success of your newborn planet! Help them as good as you can, and their spirit might award you...

[h2]Examples[/h2]
Let's take a look at some of the humans you will help in Reus 2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/fb5694d380d5fd7d3de6eb001b5800386a2659ec.png[/img]

[h3]The Goddess[/h3]
Some humies think not you, but they are the center of the universe. Arrogant, but kind of cute. The Goddess loves shows of wealth and splendor. You're sure to help her with precious stones or expensive fur. And of course, she expects that her city will be the most glorious place on the planet. Just be sure to keep her hubris in check if it grows too wild...

[h3]The Inventor[/h3]
The inventor is full of ideas! And above all, he likes to share those with the world. Create a world where ideas flow from city to city and you're sure to see curious projects and eras! He can be a bit eccentric though, and refuse to use some of the resources you give him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092750/3117ec995fcb9cd6615f78ba3d324e3bb3e7b323.png[/img]
[i]Hello.[/i]

[h3]The Game Designer[/h3]
Ah, me, the game designer. All he wants is to entertain you. A young father, he's sure not to cause you too much trouble in a quest to conquer the world or kill your gods. You can help by following the game, and suggesting what you'd like to see in our [url=https://discord.gg/TASkDsUxa5]Discord [/url]or Steam forums! I'm sure he'll appreciate.

That's the Journal entry for today, we hope you're as excited about Reus 2 as we are!

- Adriaan, Game Designer Monk at Abbey Games

notes.title: After 10 years, Reus is back!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi, I’m Louise, the Communication Manager at Firesquid. We’ve partnered with Abbey Games to publish the sequel to Reus.[/h3]

The team and I are really proud to announce [b]Reus 2[/b]! Welcome to this Steam Group where we will share big announcements, news about the game, playtest invites, etc. So don’t forget to follow us here!
As you might have seen, Reus 2 was announced during TactiCon’s showcase. If you missed our reveal trailer, have a look…

[previewyoutube=RreWiz8gy4g;full][/previewyoutube]
Since Reus (2013), many things evolved! This new title is a sequel a decade in the making. Abbey Games’ love for Reus never faded. Find what you can do in Reus 2:
[list]
[*] [b]Control Giants:[/b] Play with a roster of powerful giants as they shape planets. Foster or punish the development of human societies. The choice is yours.
[*] [b]Experiment with Natural Resources:[/b] Using different combinations of flora and fauna together can help find new interactions between these elements and witness how they change the human societies that inhabit that world.
[*] [b]Observe and Define Your Own Goals:[/b] Shape the development of humanity and watch as their societies evolve from primitive eras to advanced civilizations. Whether they are obsessed space explorers or self-destructive warmongers, who are you to judge humanity’s choices? 
[*] [b]Leave a Lasting Legacy:[/b] Each playthrough leaves a lasting legacy in the stars - and inspires new paths to take.[/list]

To give a little more info on the devs, [b]Abbey Games[/b] is a Dutch independent studio that makes deep and complex management games fun for everyone. Their debut god game Reus was a surprise hit in the summer of 2013 and their second strategy management game, Renowned Explorers, launched in 2015 to incredibly positive reviews. Their third game Godhood released in 2020.

And we are [b]Firesquid Games[/b], an indie publisher focused on games that include strategizing and thinking in their broadest sense; from tactics to city-builders or any other game where the brain is the most important muscle. Firesquid aims at developing a catalog of strategy titles that modernize and revisit their genres. Firesquid works closely with developers to help them make the best game they can, and focuses on developing communities around their strategy games.

I hope you learned more about the studios behind Reus 2. If you want to directly chat with all of us, join the [url=https://discord.gg/EANmk2rbVG]Reus 2 Discord[/url]!
